points.description: Control plane responsibility: decides/computes routes (manages network graph, sets flow tables of switches) and/or handles packets the data plane cannot process; logically centralized.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated (e.g. 'controls the network') without routing/flow-table decisions.

points.description: Data plane responsibility: forwards packets; switches simply execute actions according to flow tables set by the control plane.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'handles traffic' without forwarding per flow tables.

points.description: Names two tasks of the SDN controller from the model list (e.g. configuring forwarding tables, injecting packets, handling packet-in events, traffic statistics monitoring, topology discovery, device inventory, northbound/southbound interfaces, implementing the control plane).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.15) if only one valid task is named.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the control plane role, the data plane role, and two valid controller tasks. Give part marks for a vague role description or only one valid task. Give no marks for a part that is wrong or reversed (e.g. data plane deciding routes). The tasks must be specific items, not just 'manages the network'.
